mcq.q: Which method places the current thread into waiting state until it is notified?
When a thread calls join() on another thread, what happens?

options.C: It waits for the other thread to finish
options.D: It sleeps for a specified time

mcq.answer_text: It waits for the other thread to finish

mcq.q: Which of the following is true about the sleep() method in Java?

options.A: It releases the lock and pauses execution
options.B: It does not release any lock
options.D: It is not allowed inside synchronized blocks

mcq.answer_text: It does not release any lock

sq.q: What is the role of synchronized keyword in Java thread management?
answer: The synchronized keyword ensures mutual exclusion by allowing only one thread to access a block/method at a time. It prevents data inconsistency in concurrent environments.
